data.title: James Talarico says Ken Paxton is "lying to the people of Texas" with AI ad that puts "words in my mouth"
data.description: Democrat James Talarico told CBS News' Ed O'Keefe he won't use AI in political advertising in the race for the Texas U.S. Senate seat, adding, "every ad that we put out is made by human beings."
data.keywords: United States Senate, James Talarico, Texas, Ken Paxton
